newsitem.title: UK: NWE GAS OIL SPREADS STEADY IN LISTLESS ACTIVITY.
newsitem.headline: NWE GAS OIL SPREADS STEADY IN LISTLESS ACTIVITY.

text.p: European gas oil spreads were steady but spot physical business was lethargic on Wednesday, traders said.
Outright prices eased slightly. New IPE front month September was trading down 75 cents at $170.00 in line with Brent following bearish overnight U.S. statistics.
Business was curbed partly by the involvement of some traders in the logistics of the IPE delivery in addition to seasonal holidays and hot summer temperatures in northern Europe.
"With these sorts of temperatures perhaps it's normal there is so little business around," a German heating oil trader said.
Cargoes of German quality heating oil were bid at 75 cents over September IPE and offered at $1.50 cif NWE.
Low sulphur diesel was assessed slightly firmer around September IPE +$4.25/5.25 cif NWE.
On the ARA barge market, low sulphur diesel was bid at between $3 and $3.25 over September IPE. Offers were placed at around September IPE +$4/+$5.
Rotterdam refinery heating oil for second half August delivery was offered at screen flat, with no buying heard. Early September heating was offered at +$1.25/$1.50 cif NWE.
